scripts.dev: bun run dev:init && WISP_HOME="${WISP_DEV_HOME:-$HOME/.wisp-dev}" WISP_COMMAND_NAME=wisp-dev bun run --no-orphans --parallel dev:server dev:ui
scripts.dev:server: bun run build:ui && WISP_HOME="${WISP_DEV_HOME:-$HOME/.wisp-dev}" WISP_COMMAND_NAME=wisp-dev bun --watch --no-clear-screen wispd/src/index.ts serve
scripts.test: bun run build:ui && bun run test:root && bun run test:wispd
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:ui
scripts.lint: bunx eslint scripts tests wispd/src wispd/tests wispd/scripts
scripts.check: bun run docs:check && bun run lint:all && bun run typecheck:all && bun run test:all
scripts.check:browser-security: bun run build:ui && bun run scripts/browser-security-check.ts
scripts.build: bun run build:ui && bun run build:binary
scripts.build:linux: bun run build:ui && bun run wispd/scripts/build-binary.ts --target linux-x64 --outfile dist/wisp-linux-x64
scripts.build:macos: bun run build:ui && bun run wispd/scripts/build-binary.ts --target darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/wisp-darwin-arm64
scripts.release:linux: bun run build:ui && bun run wispd/scripts/release-linux.ts
scripts.release:macos: bun run build:ui && bun run wispd/scripts/release-macos.ts
